mapper.sql: ID, DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, COUNT, DENSITY, ALG_NAME, TASK_CODE, IMAGE_URL, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS ( DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, COUNT, DENSITY, ALG_NAME, TASK_CODE, IMAGE_URL, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{tourismName}, #{count}, #{density}, #{algName}, #{taskCode}, #{imageUrl}, #{recordTime}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS ( DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, COUNT, DENSITY, ALG_NAME, TASK_CODE, IMAGE_URL, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES
(#{item.deviceCode}, #{item.deviceName}, #{item.tourismName}, #{item.count}, #{item.density}, #{item.algName}, #{item.taskCode}, #{item.imageUrl}, #{item.recordTime}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEVICE_CODE ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC) AS RN FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS ) T WHERE RN = 1

SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS
ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST #{params.pageSize} ROWS ONLY OFFSET #{params.offset} ROWS
